# Moodle CLI 0.13.2

The private MCP server's sign-in and approval pages now show your Moodle site's icon.

- The Worker fetches the icon from your Moodle site and inlines it, so the pages still load nothing from other hosts.
- A site that hides its icon behind single sign-on falls back to the Moodle logo.

Run `moodle mcp deploy` again to pick this up. The CLI and MCP tools are unchanged from 0.13.1.
